question: Who among the following personalities was awarded the Padma Shri for his contribution to Bundeli Folk Dance in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ram Sahay Pandey**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ram Sahay Pandey** was awarded the Padma Shri for his contribution to Bundeli Folk Dance in 2022.
 
• Ram Sahay Panday is a Rai dancer from Madhya Pradesh's sagar district.
 
• **The Rai** dance was traditionally associated with the Bedia community.
 
• Though he was not the member of the community he devoted his whole life practicing and performing the **Rai dance** and to secure acceptance and respectability for the dance form.
 
• His efforts helped him obtain national and international recognition of **Rai dance** form.
 
• The dance form Raai (or Rai) is basically a folk dance of the **Bundelkhand region**. 
 
• In the year 2022, Govt of India honoured Ram Sahay Panday by conferring the **Padma Shri** award for his contributions to art.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ravi Shankar Sharma**, often referred to mononymously as Ravi, was an Indian music director, who composed music for several Hindi and Malayalam films.
 
• **Dinesh Kumar Barkesia **is an Indian choreographer working with South Indian films, including Tamil films. He won the 2011 National Film Award for Best Choreography for his work in Aadukalam.
